skill_concept: Configure and apply LoRA adapters to HuggingFace models using the PEFT library — covering both loading pre-trained adapters (PeftModel.from_pretrained + merge_and_unload) and training new adapters from scratch (LoraConfig + get_peft_model + Trainer fine-tuning loop).
verdict_reason: Both tasks share the same PEFT-library procedure shape: configure a LoraConfig (or load one), attach it to a HuggingFace model, and either merge+save (hf-lora-adapter) or train+save (hf-train-lora-adapter). The candidate skill explicitly covers both branches, so a single skill document with two code paths would meaningfully guide an agent through either task.
weakest_link_reason: This task adds a full supervised fine-tuning loop (Trainer, DataCollator, dataset formatting, tokenizer padding setup) on top of the core LoRA wiring, requiring substantially more procedural knowledge beyond what 'configure and apply a LoRA adapter' alone captures.
